admission.authority: direct user continuation of the main-backed BRC multiplier transport program plus exact static and dynamic odd-N 2-adic scan reductions
admission.reason: Strict extension of exact multiplier root/remainder transport: odd-N mod-4 impossibility, exact m=4 mod 8 witness reduction, state-dependent even-ceiling-root reduction for 4-divisible multipliers, structural factor-pair priority, and direct m=1 to target-m BRC jumps.

methods.name: BRC prioritized direct multiplier jump / 2-adic irredundant scan
capabilities: exact elimination of odd-N multipliers m congruent 2 or 6 mod 8 as impossible difference-of-squares targets
exact reduction of every successful immediate witness at m congruent 4 mod 8 to the smaller multiplier m/4 with the same gcd factor
scan-complete odd-N static multiplier representative residues {0,1,3,5,7} mod 8
exact N-visible repeated m->m/4 reduction when the already-known BRC ceiling root is even
exact impossibility diagnosis when dynamic reduction lands in a 2 mod 4 target or a 4 mod 8 target with odd reduced ceiling root
state-level gap-test irredundancy readout without changing the static candidate set
same-parity multiplier factor-pair structural scoring on the exact representative set
direct exact BRC transport from the retained m=1 root/remainder state to arbitrary target m<=100
proved at-most-11 odd-basin corrections for direct jumps
methods.core_law: For odd N, m congruent 2 or 6 mod 8 is impossible as a difference of squares. If 4 divides m and an immediate ceiling-square witness has even ceiling root x, then its gap root is even and dividing x,y,m by 2,2,4 gives the same immediate witness and gcd factor at m/4; this may be repeated using the halved ceiling root. The static special case m=4*l with l odd therefore makes every 4 mod 8 multiplier redundant and leaves residues {0,1,3,5,7} mod 8 scan-complete. For target t<=100 the retained m=1 BRC state reaches t exactly with at most 11 odd-basin corrections.
methods.hard_boundary: Difference-of-squares feasibility, static scan irredundancy, and state-dependent gap-test irredundancy are distinct. The static/dynamic 2-adic reductions and direct jump are exact; the same-parity factor-pair ranking is only a finite empirically useful heuristic and is not claimed optimal. Retained 0 mod 8 states with odd ceiling root can be genuine first hits, so that class cannot be uniformly deleted. Multiplier-Fermat/Hart/Lehman remains classical prior art. No global novelty priority, asymptotic factorization speedup, theorem about semiprime ratio distributions, or Foundation promotion is claimed.
